generated.researchQuestion:
Main question: Among adolescents in kinship foster care in Arizona, how do caregiver warmth and school stability relate to school engagement?

Subquestions:
1. Does self-efficacy explain these relationships?
generated.hypotheses:
H1 (direct): Higher caregiver warmth will be associated with higher self-efficacy.

H2 (direct): Higher school stability will be associated with higher self-efficacy.

H3 (direct): Higher self-efficacy will be associated with higher school engagement.

H4 (direct): Higher school stability will be associated with higher school engagement.

H5 (mediation): Self-efficacy will completely mediate the link from caregiver warmth, and partially mediate the link from school stability, to school engagement.
